text: Once upon a time a small robot opened a blue box. Inside was a red ball. The robot gave the ball to a friend. Together they played in the garden until the sun went down.
Once upon a time a girl found a little boat by the river. She painted the boat green and gave it a yellow flag. Her brother helped her carry it home. They made a small pond for the boat.
Once upon a time a dog met a bird near a tree. The bird was looking for a seed. The dog found one beside a stone. They shared a happy day and became good friends.
